english: I'm not above making niceties with the little people. Hello to you.
french: Tu noteras que je n'ai rien contre les petites gens. Bien le bonjour, d'ailleurs.
russian: Я не чураюсь знакомств с простолюдинами. Привет тебе.
bulgarian: I'm not above making niceties with the little people. Hello to you.

english: But when I was quizzing her about it, she said her business partner, Dozy, helped her prepare it.
french: Lorsque je l'ai interrogée sur sa façon de faire, elle m'a dit que son collaborateur, Dozy, l'avait aidée.
russian: А когда я стал про него расспрашивать, она сказала, что пирог помогал готовить её партнёр Дрёма.
bulgarian: But when I was quizzing her about it, she said her business partner, Dozy, helped her prepare it.

english: Dozy... is a dog.
french: Dozy est... un chien.
russian: Дрёма... это пёс.
bulgarian: Dozy... is a dog.

english: I shouldn't expect these village rubes to know about sanitary preparation, but nonetheless... I do. DISQUALIFIED!
french: Je ne m'attends pas à ce que les rustres de ce patelin connaissent toutes les règles d'hygiène, mais il y a des limites... DISQUALIFIÉE !
russian: Мне не стоило ждать от этой деревенщины соблюдения правил гигиены, и всё же... Я ждал. ДИСКВАЛИФИЦИРОВАНА!
bulgarian: I shouldn't expect these village rubes to know about sanitary preparation, but nonetheless... I do. DISQUALIFIED!

english: That ill-natured woman with the gaudy boots, Juniper... She entered her $Bell Berry Bakewell Tart$ into the $Cooking Challenge$.
french: Cette femme désagréable au possible, chaussée de bottes d'un goût douteux, Juniper... Elle a présenté sa $tarte aux clocherelles$ pour le $défi gastronomique$.
russian: Женщина в броских сапогах и с дурными манерами, Джунипер... Она принесла $тарт из колокольника$ на $смотр блюд$.
bulgarian: That ill-natured woman with the gaudy boots, Juniper... She entered her $Bell Berry Bakewell Tart$ into the $Cooking Challenge$.

english: When I told her she failed utterly, she laughed at me! You know, I don't think she's taking my challenges very seriously.
french: Quand je lui ai fait savoir qu'elle avait lamentablement échoué, elle m'a ri au nez ! Je crois qu'elle ne prend pas mes défis très au sérieux.
russian: Когда я сообщил ей, что она с треском провалилась, она рассмеялась мне в лицо! По-моему, она не воспринимает мои задания всерьёз.
bulgarian: When I told her she failed utterly, she laughed at me! You know, I don't think she's taking my challenges very seriously.

english: I should file a complaint!
french: Je devrais porter plainte !
russian: Пора написать на неё жалобу!
bulgarian: I should file a complaint!

english: The little hellion, Dell... she turned in a mud pie for the $Chocolate Cake$ Challenge!
french: Cette petite chipie de Dell... Elle a préparé une tarte à la boue pour le défi du $gâteau au chocolat$ !
russian: Эта хулиганка Делл... На конкурс $шоколадных тортов$ принесла пирог из грязи!
bulgarian: The little hellion, Dell... she turned in a mud pie for the $Chocolate Cake$ Challenge!

english: But don't worry, I kindly gave him some advice.
french: Mais ne t'en fais pas, je lui ai donné un bon conseil :
russian: Но можешь не волноваться, я дал ему добрый совет.
bulgarian: But don't worry, I kindly gave him some advice.

english: I told him to leave the cooking to the experts!
french: Laisser la cuisine aux experts !
russian: А именно: сказал оставить готовку специалистам!
bulgarian: I told him to leave the cooking to the experts!

english: The burly curator, Errol... his $Crispy Fried Earthshroom$ was a disaster. More like Extra Soggy Earthshroom!
french: Le costaud qui est conservateur du musée, Errol... son $beignet de terramanite$ était une horreur. C'était plus de la bouillie de terramanite !
russian: Этот Эррол, бугай-куратор... приготовил настоящую катастрофу: не $земляные грибы в кляре$, а земляные грибы в слизи!
bulgarian: The burly curator, Errol... his $Crispy Fried Earthshroom$ was a disaster. More like Extra Soggy Earthshroom!

english: But he just made me look at his crystal collection!
french: Non, il m'a juste montré sa collection de cristaux !
russian: А он заставил меня рассматривать его коллекцию кристаллов!
bulgarian: But he just made me look at his crystal collection!

english: For an hour!
french: Ça a duré une heure !
russian: На протяжении часа!
bulgarian: For an hour!

english: That walking muscle, Olric... he stopped by earlier. I thought he was here to drop off his entry for the $Crystal Berry Pie$ Challenge...
french: Cette espèce de colosse, Olric, est passé tout à l'heure... Je croyais qu'il déposait sa création pour le défi de la $tarte aux baies de cristal$...
russian: Ольрик, эта ходячая гора мышц, недавно заходил... Я думал, он хочет отдать на смотр $пирог из кристальных ягод$...
bulgarian: That walking muscle, Olric... he stopped by earlier. I thought he was here to drop off his entry for the $Crystal Berry Pie$ Challenge...

english: But her dish was covered in edible flowers!
french: Mais son plat était recouvert de fleurs comestibles !
russian: Но у неё всё блюдо было усыпано съедобными цветами!
bulgarian: But her dish was covered in edible flowers!

english: I asked for an $Herb Salad$, not a flower arrangement! There will be no embellishments in my $Cooking Challenge$!
french: J'ai demandé une $salade aux herbes$, pas une composition florale ! Les fioritures n'ont pas leur place dans mes $défis gastronomiques$.
russian: Я просил $зелёный салат$, а не цветочные узоры! У меня на $смотре блюд$ прошу обойтись без украшений!
bulgarian: I asked for an $Herb Salad$, not a flower arrangement! There will be no embellishments in my $Cooking Challenge$!

english: That blonde woman with the dirt under her fingernails... Celine. She attempted my $Herb Salad$ Challenge.
french: Céline, la petite blonde avec de la terre sous les ongles... Elle a voulu participer au défi de la $salade aux herbes$.
russian: Селин, эта блондинка с грязью под ногтями... попыталась сделать для смотра $зелёный салат$.
bulgarian: That blonde woman with the dirt under her fingernails... Celine. She attempted my $Herb Salad$ Challenge.

english: This $Cooking Challenge$ is not about putting your own twist on it!
french: Le but du $défi gastronomique$ n'est pas de faire « sa recette » !
russian: В моём $смотре блюд$ отсебятина не принимается!
bulgarian: This $Cooking Challenge$ is not about putting your own twist on it!

english: And also? Too spicy!
french: En plus, c'était bien trop épicé !
russian: К тому же знаешь, что? Было слишком остро!
bulgarian: And also? Too spicy!

english: The old fisherwoman, Terithia... she said she had her own twist on the =Incredibly Hot Pot=.
french: Cette vieille pêcheuse, Terithia... elle prétendait avoir sa recette à elle du =ragoût super épicé=.
russian: Эта старая рыбачка, Теризия... сказала, что у неё своя версия =обжигающего жаркого=.
bulgarian: The old fisherwoman, Terithia... she said she had her own twist on the =Incredibly Hot Pot=.

english: But he made one mistake. His omelet... was too big!
french: Mais il a commis une erreur. Son omelette était bien trop grosse !
russian: Но в одном он ошибся. Его омлет был... слишком большой!
bulgarian: But he made one mistake. His omelet... was too big!

english: He said it was because he likes to share... unsophisticated! Naive!
french: Il a dit que c'était parce qu'il aime bien partager... Quel rustaud ! Naïf, même !
russian: Он сказал, что любит делиться... Как безыскусно! Как наивно!
bulgarian: He said it was because he likes to share... unsophisticated! Naive!

english: That brawny farmer in need of a haircut, Hayden... he almost passed my $Omelet$ challenge.
french: Le fermier bourru qui aurait bien besoin d'aller chez le coiffeur, Hayden... Il a failli réussir mon défi de l'$omelette$.
russian: Этому здоровому фермеру, Хейдену, не помешала бы стрижка... но он почти победил в смотре $омлета$.
bulgarian: That brawny farmer in need of a haircut, Hayden... he almost passed my $Omelet$ challenge.

english: I suppose even the nobles put their hands to work, out here in the sticks.
french: J'imagine que dans les trous perdus, même les nobles mettent la main à la pâte.
russian: Видимо, в здешней глуши даже знать вынуждена готовить.
bulgarian: I suppose even the nobles put their hands to work, out here in the sticks.

english: But his $Rice Ball$ was studded with chocolate chips. There's a recipe for a reason! No embellishments!
french: Enfin, sa $boulette de riz$ était truffée de pépites de chocolat. S'il existe une recette, il faut la suivre ! Pas de fioritures !
russian: Но его $рисовый шарик$ был покрыт шоколадной крошкой. Существует ведь рецепт! Никаких приукрашиваний!
bulgarian: But his $Rice Ball$ was studded with chocolate chips. There's a recipe for a reason! No embellishments!

english: That princely fellow whose hair nearly rivals mine... Eiland. He entered my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.
french: Cet aristocrate dont la coiffure pourrait presque rivaliser avec la mienne, Eiland... Il a participé à mon défi de la $boulette de riz$.
russian: У этого парня благородного вида, Эйланда, причёска едва уступает моей... Он участвовал в моём смотре $рисовых шариков$.
bulgarian: That princely fellow whose hair nearly rivals mine... Eiland. He entered my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.

english: How did he get the shape wrong? It's in the name!
french: Comment a-t-il pu se tromper sur la forme ? C'est dans le nom du plat !
russian: Даже форма указана в названии! Как он умудрился перепутать?
bulgarian: How did he get the shape wrong? It's in the name!

english: And let me tell you, it's not the Rice Ingot Challenge!
french: Je n'ai pas lancé le défi du lingot de riz, que je sache !
russian: Знаешь, я ведь не писал «смотр рисовых слитков»!
bulgarian: And let me tell you, it's not the Rice Ingot Challenge!

english: That blacksmith with the attitude, March... he submitted his entry for my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.
french: March, le forgeron au caractère de cochon... Il a participé au défi de la $boulette de riz$.
russian: Этот хамоватый кузнец Март... приготовил мне на смотр $рисовый шарик$.
bulgarian: That blacksmith with the attitude, March... he submitted his entry for my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.

english: Only she replaced half the ingredients with something she deemed healthier. And then she left out the salt!
french: Mais elle a remplacé la moitié des ingrédients par d'autres qu'elle juge plus sains. Et elle n'a pas mis de sel !
russian: Вот только половину ингредиентов она заменила, по её мнению, более здоровыми. И совсем не добавила соли!
bulgarian: Only she replaced half the ingredients with something she deemed healthier. And then she left out the salt!

english: You know what I call a salad like that? Compost!
french: Tu sais le nom que je donne à ce genre de salade ? Du compost !
russian: Знаешь, как я называю такой салат? Компост!
bulgarian: You know what I call a salad like that? Compost!

english: That haughty doctor, Valen... she turned in her $Tide Salad$ for my $Cooking Challenge$.
french: La docteure arrogante, Valen... Elle a présenté sa $salade des marées$ pour mon $défi gastronomique$.
russian: Эта гордая врачиха, Вален... принесла мне на $смотр блюд$ свой $подводный салат$.
bulgarian: That haughty doctor, Valen... she turned in her $Tide Salad$ for my $Cooking Challenge$.

english: But when I asked him to show me the sandwich, he told me he ate it!
french: Mais quand je lui ai demandé de me montrer son sandwich, il m'a répondu qu'il l'avait mangé !
russian: А когда я попросил его показать блюдо, он сказал, что его съел!
bulgarian: But when I asked him to show me the sandwich, he told me he ate it!

english: That's not a Cooking Challenge! That's lunch!
french: Ce n'est plus un défi gastronomique, c'est un véritable repas !
russian: У меня же тут кулинарный конкурс, а не обед!
bulgarian: That's not a Cooking Challenge! That's lunch!

english: That mustachioed buffoon, Holt... he decided to take on the =Veggie Sub Sandwich= Challenge.
french: Ce pitre à la grosse moustache, Holt... Il a décidé de s'essayer au défi du =sandwich aux légumes=.
russian: Этот усатый клоун, Хольт... решил принять участие в смотре =овощного сэндвича=.
bulgarian: That mustachioed buffoon, Holt... he decided to take on the =Veggie Sub Sandwich= Challenge.

english: I'm your host... Taliferro.
french: Je me présente... Taliferro.
russian: Его провожу я... Талиферро.
bulgarian: I'm your host... Taliferro.

english: I'm not sure what the $Merchant's Association$ is thinking, having Wheedle and I set up out here in the sticks.
french: Je ne sais pas ce qui a pris à la $guilde des marchands$ de nous envoyer Wheedle et moi dans ce trou perdu.
russian: Не знаю, о чём думали в $гильдии торговцев$, когда послали нас с Хлюстом в эту глухомань.
bulgarian: I'm not sure what the $Merchant's Association$ is thinking, having Wheedle and I set up out here in the sticks.

english: I can't say I have particularly high expectations.
french: Je ne dirai pas que je m'attends à grand-chose.
russian: Не сказал бы, что у меня есть какие-то ожидания.
bulgarian: I can't say I have particularly high expectations.

english: But if you do manage to complete my $Cooking Challenges$, you'll be rewarded with $Renown$ and $a variety of prizes$.
french: Mais si tu parviens à relever mes $défis gastronomiques$, tu recevras de la $renommée$ et $diverses récompenses$.
russian: Но если ты справишься с моими $смотрами блюд$, тебя ждёт награда: $репутация$ и $разнообразные призы$.
bulgarian: But if you do manage to complete my $Cooking Challenges$, you'll be rewarded with $Renown$ and $a variety of prizes$.

english: If you're interested, be sure to check out the $Challenge Board$ here at my booth on $Saturdays$.
french: Si cela t'intéresse, n'hésite pas à consulter le $panneau des défis$ ici, à mon stand, chaque $samedi$.
russian:
Если ты

заинтересованы

заинтересованазаинтересованзаинтересовано, подойди к $доске смотров$ в моей лавке в $субботу$.
bulgarian: If you're interested, be sure to check out the $Challenge Board$ here at my booth on $Saturdays$.

english: You must complete each $Challenge$ before you can move on to the next round.
french: Tu dois terminer chaque $défi$ avant de pouvoir passer au suivant.
russian: Каждый $смотр$ обязательно пройти, чтобы перейти в следующий раунд.
bulgarian: You must complete each $Challenge$ before you can move on to the next round.

english: Good luck, [Ari]. You'll need it.
french: Bonne chance, [Ari]. Tu en auras bien besoin.
russian: Удачи, [Ari]. Без неё тебе не обойтись.
bulgarian: Good luck, [Ari]. You'll need it.

english: Welcome to Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$.
french: Bienvenue au $défi gastronomique$ de Taliferro.
russian: Добро пожаловать на $смотр блюд$ Талиферро.
bulgarian: Welcome to Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$.

english: The booth is closed, [Ari]. You know what closed means, don't you?
french: Mon stand est fermé, [Ari]. Tu sais ce que signifie « fermé », n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Моя лавка закрыта, [Ari]. Знаешь, что такое «закрыто»?
bulgarian: The booth is closed, [Ari]. You know what closed means, don't you?

english: Okay, I'm done counting. But still, be silent!
french: Bon, j'ai terminé, mais quoi qu'il en soit... silence !
russian: Ладно, пересчитал. Но всё равно помолчи!
bulgarian: Okay, I'm done counting. But still, be silent!

english: Silence! I'm counting my silverware.
french: Silence ! Je recompte mes couverts en argent.
russian: Тихо! Я пересчитываю столовые приборы.
bulgarian: Silence! I'm counting my silverware.

english: A shame such colorful views are wasted on these country folk.
french: Quel dommage que ces rustres soient incapables de l'apprécier !
russian: Жаль, что такие красочные виды достаются деревенским бездарям.
bulgarian: A shame such colorful views are wasted on these country folk.

english: The leaves here are picturesque in the fall... a perfect backdrop for the close of Market day.
french: Les feuilles d'automne donnent une touche artistique à la place... C'est parfait pour conclure le marché.
russian: Осенью здесь такая живописная листва... Идеальный фон для закрытия базара.
bulgarian: The leaves here are picturesque in the fall... a perfect backdrop for the close of Market day.

english: How am I supposed to pack up when there's three mice running amuck in my kitchen?
french: Comment suis-je censé tout ranger avec trois souris qui mettent le bazar dans ma cuisine ?
russian: Ну и как прикажете собираться, когда у меня на кухне мельтешат трое мышей?
bulgarian: How am I supposed to pack up when there's three mice running amuck in my kitchen?

english: Those children were here earlier, rifling through all my cabinets...
french: Les enfants qui étaient là tout à l'heure n'arrêtaient pas de fouiner dans tous mes placards...
russian: Недавно ко мне прибежали дети и стали рыться в моих шкафах...
bulgarian: Those children were here earlier, rifling through all my cabinets...

english: How am I supposed to pack up when there's snow all over the counter!
french: Impossible de ranger mon stand avec un plan de travail couvert de neige !
russian: Как мне собирать вещи, если у меня весь прилавок в снегу?
bulgarian: How am I supposed to pack up when there's snow all over the counter!

english: Winter is exactly why I prefer indoor kitchens.
french: C'est à cause de l'hiver que je préfère cuisiner en intérieur.
russian: Я предпочитаю держать кухню в помещении как раз из-за такой зимы.
bulgarian: Winter is exactly why I prefer indoor kitchens.

english: Because I'm cold, that's why!
french: Parce que j'ai froid, tout simplement !
russian: Потому что я замёрз, вот почему!
bulgarian: Because I'm cold, that's why!

english: The $Cooking Challenge$ is closed for the day. Why?
french: Il n'y a pas de $défi gastronomique$, aujourd'hui. Tu veux savoir pourquoi.
russian: $Смотр блюд$ на сегодня закончен. Почему?
bulgarian: The $Cooking Challenge$ is closed for the day. Why?

english: Do I not look busy to you? Do you not see me packing up the pots and pans?
french: Tu trouves que j'ai l'air de me tourner les pouces ? Tu vois bien que je remballe mes marmites et mes poêles.
russian: По мне не заметно, что я занят? Ты не видишь, что я собираю кастрюли и сковородки?
bulgarian: Do I not look busy to you? Do you not see me packing up the pots and pans?

english: Begone, peasant!
french: Dégage, plouc !
russian: Прочь, деревня!
bulgarian: Begone, peasant!

english: The Market day is over, so I can dispense with the pleasantries.
french: Le marché est terminé. Je n'ai plus besoin d'être aimable.
russian: Базарный день закончился, так что я могу отбросить любезности.
bulgarian: The Market day is over, so I can dispense with the pleasantries.

english: Someone of my pedigree? And on a full stomach?
french: Quelqu'un de mon rang ! Qui a l'estomac plein !
russian: С моей-то родословной? И на полный желудок?
bulgarian: Someone of my pedigree? And on a full stomach?

english: I sample so many dishes throughout the day... and now I have to do the manual labor of packing the booth?
french: Je goûte déjà de nombreux plats tout au long de la journée... et en plus, je dois tout remballer moi-même !
russian: Я должен попробовать столько блюд за день... А теперь ещё и вынужден сам собирать лавку?
bulgarian: I sample so many dishes throughout the day... and now I have to do the manual labor of packing the booth?

english: But for some reason they don't seem to appreciate my presence. Perhaps they're intimidated?
french: Bizarrement, ils ne semblent guère apprécier ma présence, là-bas. Peut-être que je les intimide ?
russian: Хотя там по какой-то причине не очень рады моим визитам. Может, они меня боятся?
bulgarian: But for some reason they don't seem to appreciate my presence. Perhaps they're intimidated?

english: Who can blame them!
french: Ma foi, c'est bien normal !
russian: Не могу их винить!
bulgarian: Who can blame them!

english: Once I'm done packing up, perhaps I'll visit the Inn.
french: Quand j'aurai terminé de ranger, je ferai peut-être un saut à l'auberge.
russian: Возможно, когда закончу собирать вещи, загляну в трактир.
bulgarian: Once I'm done packing up, perhaps I'll visit the Inn.

english: Unbelievable. These yokels should be tripping over themselves offering to help me.
french: Je n'y crois pas. Ces paysans devraient faire la queue pour me proposer leur aide.
russian: Невероятно. Эти вахлаки должны в очередь выстраиваться, чтобы мне помочь.
bulgarian: Unbelievable. These yokels should be tripping over themselves offering to help me.

english: Are you here to pack up my booth? No?
french: Tu viens m'aider à remballer mon stand ? Ah non ?
russian:
Ты

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло собрать мою лавку? Нет?
bulgarian: Are you here to pack up my booth? No?

english: No one has ever suffered as greatly as I.
french: Personne n'a jamais souffert comme je souffre.
russian: Никому ещё не доводилось так страдать!
bulgarian: No one has ever suffered as greatly as I.

english: I can't believe I'm expected to pack up my booth in this summer heat.
french: Je n'arrive pas à le croire. Il faut que je remballe mon stand par cette chaleur.
russian: Поверить не могу, что мне надо собирать свою лавку в летнюю жару.
bulgarian: I can't believe I'm expected to pack up my booth in this summer heat.

english: If you're here for the $Cooking Challenge$, come back next week!
french: Si tu es là pour le $défi gastronomique$, reviens la semaine prochaine !
russian: Если ты на $смотр блюд$, то приходи на следующей неделе!
bulgarian: If you're here for the $Cooking Challenge$, come back next week!

english: Can't you see the booth is closed?
french: Tu ne vois pas que mon stand est fermé ?
russian: Не видишь, у меня закрыто!
bulgarian: Can't you see the booth is closed?

english: But I don't trust any of these buffoons to keep my cookware intact!
french: Mais je n'ai aucune confiance en ces rustres. Ils risquent d'abîmer ma batterie de cuisine !
russian: Но я никому из этих клоунов не доверю мою посуду!
